missing_information_behavior: Do not add or suggest another omega-3 product until EPA and DHA amounts, serving frequency, product form and relevant medicines are confirmed.
safety_exclusions: Do not use total fish-oil mass as a substitute for EPA+DHA content.
Do not assume products have equivalent EPA/DHA concentrations.
Do not duplicate an existing product or imply more is always better.
professional_escalation_conditions: Anticoagulant/antiplatelet use, bleeding disorder, planned surgery, atrial fibrillation or high-dose use.
Pregnancy, significant cardiovascular disease or unexplained adverse effects.
population_and_context: People already using omega-3 products; total EPA and DHA per actual daily serving must be known before any additional suggestion.
dose_constraints: Reconcile total EPA+DHA from all products; no additional dose from this rule. Use indication-specific guidance and clinician review where relevant.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Omega-3 fact sheet distinguishes forms and EPA/DHA content and summarizes safety. Product label and actual serving are essential for exposure assessment.
